parameters.content:
## 1. TRIGGER
Webhook receives JotForm POST at /ugc-onboarding
JotForm sends data in inconsistent formats — the Code node handles all parsing.

## 2. PARSE & GENERATE CLIENT CODE
Handles 3 JotForm data formats:
1. body.rawRequest (JSON string)
2. Numbered q-fields (q1_whatIs, etc.)
3. Direct field names

Also generates client code: ABC-MMDD

## 3. GOOGLE SHEETS — Client Database
Appends a row with all 28 columns (A–AB) to the main client database sheet.
Placeholder document ID — replace with your actual Google Sheet ID.

## 4. CLICKUP — Create Folder (HTTP Request)
POST /api/v2/space/90165772240/folder
Creates "[Brand] - UGC" folder. Uses HTTP Request to bypass n8n ClickUp node dropdown issues.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.folder_name }) }}

parameters.content:
## 5. CLICKUP — Create List (HTTP Request)
POST /api/v2/folder/{id}/list
Creates pipeline list inside new folder. Uses HTTP Request to bypass dropdown issues.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.list_name }) }}

parameters.content:
## 6. GENERATE TASKS
Code node builds an array of 10 onboarding tasks with:
- Due dates (today + N days as Unix ms)
- Priorities (1=urgent → 4=low)
- Rich descriptions with client context

## 7. SPLIT & CREATE TASKS (HTTP Request)
Loops through 10 tasks one at a time (batch size 1)
to avoid ClickUp rate limits.
POST /api/v2/list/{id}/task — uses HTTP Request node.

## 8. SLACK NOTIFICATION
Posts to #channel C07MN9QA1R7 with a summary of the new client.
Non-critical — continues on fail so it doesn't block the workflow.

## 9. ONBOARDING LOG
Appends a success record to the Onboarding Log sheet.
Tracks which steps ran and any errors.

## 10. RESPOND TO WEBHOOK
Returns JSON to JotForm with status, client code, and brand name.
This is the "Last Node" response for the webhook.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', client_code: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.client_code, brand: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.brand_name }) }}

parameters.content:
## ERROR HANDLING
If any node in the main flow fails, this error branch:
1. Sends a Slack DM to U06P9F49BJT
2. Logs the failure to the Onboarding Log sheet
3. Returns 200 to prevent JotForm retry loops

## 5b. CLICKUP — Create Chat Channel (HTTP Request)
POST /api/v3/workspaces/90161381822/chat/channels
Creates a "[Brand] - UGC" Chat Channel so the team can communicate about this client.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $('Parse JotForm & Generate Client Code').first().json.channel_name }) }}

## TEST TRIGGER
Click "Test workflow" to run the entire flow with demo data.
No webhook needed — Manual Trigger outputs raw form data that
flows through the Parse node, so all downstream references work.
Disable this path in production by deactivating the Manual Trigger node.
